cc:Work.dc:title: communication-study-linear-modulation
cc:Work.dc:description: Three schematic bilateral Fourier spectra for a common bandlimited message show AM with carrier impulses, DSB-SC with mirrored sidebands and upper SSB with conjugate negative-frequency mirror. Spectrum shapes are normalized schematics, not PSDs or equal-power comparisons. A separate single-tone AM example uses mu=0.7, fm=1 kHz and fc=12 kHz.
